info.name: Clearwake PayPal sandbox read only calls
info.description: Read only copy of the Clearwake collection: token, list disputes, get dispute. Nothing here changes state at PayPal.

exec: // Sandbox only. Refuse any other host, then make sure a token exists.
const base = pm.environment.get('base_url') || '';
if (base !== 'https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com') { throw new Error('base_url must be https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com. Clearwake never calls production.'); }
if (pm.request.url.getPath().indexOf('/v1/oauth2/token') !== -1) { return; }
if (pm.environment.get('access_token')) { return; }
const id = pm.environment.get('client_id'), secret = pm.environment.get('client_secret');
if (!id || !secret) { throw new Error('Fill client_id and client_secret in the environment (your own sandbox app).'); }
const basic = CryptoJS.enc.Base64.stringify(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(id + ':' + secret));
pm.sendRequest({url: base + '/v1/oauth2/token', method: 'POST', header: {Authorization: 'Basic ' + basic, 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
body: {mode: 'urlencoded', urlencoded: [{key: 'grant_type', value: 'client_credentials'}]}}, (err, res) => {
if (err || res.code !== 200) { throw new Error('Token request failed'); }
pm.environment.set('access_token', res.json().access_token);
const body = () => { try { return pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { return {}; } };
pm.test('response time under 15 s (Clearwake timeout)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(15000));
pm.test('no PayPal debug id leaks a secret: body has no client secret', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.environment.get('client_secret') || '\u0000'));
pm.test('status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('token_type is Bearer', () => pm.expect(String(body().token_type).toLowerCase()).to.eql('bearer'));
pm.test('access_token is a non-empty string without line breaks', () => { const t = body().access_token; pm.expect(t).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(t).to.not.match(/[\r\n]/); });
pm.test('expires_in is an integer of at least 60', () => { const n = body().expires_in; pm.expect(Number.isInteger(n)).to.be.true; pm.expect(n).to.be.at.least(60); });
pm.environment.set('access_token', body().access_token);

request.description: clearwake/paypal.py SandboxGateway._access_token. Clearwake accepts a token only if it is a non-empty string, token_type Bearer and expires_in at least 60.

exec: const body = () => { try { return pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { return {}; } };
pm.test('response time under 15 s (Clearwake timeout)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(15000));
pm.test('no PayPal debug id leaks a secret: body has no client secret', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.environment.get('client_secret') || '\u0000'));
pm.test('status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('items is an array (empty when no dispute is open)', () => pm.expect(body().items === undefined || Array.isArray(body().items)).to.be.true);

pm.test('each item has a dispute id, a status and a life cycle stage', () => (body().items || []).forEach(d => { pm.expect(d.dispute_id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.status).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.dispute_life_cycle_stage).to.be.a('string'); }));
if (!pm.environment.get('dispute_id') && (body().items || []).length) { pm.environment.set('dispute_id', body().items[0].dispute_id); }

request.description: SandboxGateway.disputes. Clearwake lists the sandbox disputes opened by the sandbox buyer in the Resolution Center. This request stores the first dispute id in dispute_id if none is set.

exec: const body = () => { try { return pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { return {}; } };
pm.test('response time under 15 s (Clearwake timeout)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(15000));
pm.test('no PayPal debug id leaks a secret: body has no client secret', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include(pm.environment.get('client_secret') || '\u0000'));
pm.test('status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('dispute_id equals the request', () => pm.expect(body().dispute_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('dispute_id')));
pm.test('life cycle stage is INQUIRY, CHARGEBACK or PRE_ARBITRATION', () => pm.expect(body().dispute_life_cycle_stage).to.be.oneOf(['INQUIRY', 'CHARGEBACK', 'PRE_ARBITRATION', 'ARBITRATION']));
pm.test('status is a known dispute status', () => pm.expect(body().status).to.be.oneOf(['OPEN', 'WAITING_FOR_BUYER_RESPONSE', 'WAITING_FOR_SELLER_RESPONSE', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'RESOLVED', 'OTHER']));

pm.test('dispute amount is USD with two decimals', () => { const a = body().dispute_amount; pm.expect(a.currency_code).to.eql('USD'); pm.expect(a.value).to.match(/^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})\.[0-9]{2}$/); });
pm.test('a disputed transaction names the seller transaction', () => pm.expect(body().disputed_transactions[0].seller_transaction_id).to.be.a('string'));
pm.test('links list the actions PayPal offers', () => pm.expect(body().links).to.be.an('array'));
const offered = (body().links || []).map(l => l.rel); console.log('PayPal offers: ' + offered.join(', '));

request.description: SandboxGateway.dispute. Clearwake reads the dispute for its stage, status, deadline, messages and the actions PayPal offers (links). The read after every action is the proof.
